Ten years, in three tiers. Job and supplier paperwork move together because

There is NO delete action in this policy, and adding one would be a mistake.
A lifecycle rule that deletes is one mistyped prefix away from destroying a
file a dispute depends on, and blob deletion is not something an operator can
undo. Retention end raises a review in the app (GET /api/documents/retention);
a person with ApproveRetention decides, in writing, with a reason, and that
decision lands in the audit trail. Destroying anything is then a separate,
deliberate act against the storage account.
tierToCool and tierToArchive are safe in a way delete is not: a wrongly tiered
blob costs a rehydration wait, not the file.
